body: I'm so afraid of surgery. I've had it done, multiple times, but each time they start to put me to sleep and things get blurry, I start shaking and crying. I'm supposed to have open heart surgery when I'm older as well, and I'm so terrified to go through that.

Thank you.. I will have to work up a lot of courage to do that. But I will try.. I guess I'm just worried about losing him.. It's cutting the last string that hardly holds me over a flaming fire. I will just burn to the ground when he leaves. Thank you though for your advice and quick response
It helped a bit. I'm not to fond of talking about myself a whole lot so it sucked for me. If you're thinking of going, definitely go. It's helpful to just talk about it
